title: Accessibility | Apple Developer Documentation - [visionOS](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility\#visionOS)
claim: visionOS offers a variety of accessibility features people can use to interact with their surroundings in ways that are comfortable and work best for them, including head and hand Pointer Control, and a Zoom feature.
